POL

Training Provider Audit/ Evaluation
Form- Section 11.2- TACM

Audit/ Evaluation of Training Providers which the company utilises should be regularly done including
evaluation of company specific courses conducted by such institutes or facilities.

Periodic audit of these facilities should be carried with an interval of 18-24 months.

The audit/ evaluation can be carried out whilst visiting the Training Provider or remotely online

* Required

1. Name of the Training Provider *
2. Address of the Training Provider *

3. Contact details of the Training Provider *

1/18/2022
